title: Check: volumes
description: Five questions on attaching storage to a Pod.

questions.prompt: What is the lifetime of an emptyDir volume?

options.text: As long as the Pod lives on that node
As long as the container lives

questions.explanation: It survives container restarts but dies with the Pod. Good for scratch space and for sharing files between containers in one Pod.

options.text: It ties the Pod to one node and exposes the node filesystem

questions.explanation: It breaks portability and is a well-known escape route. Fine for node agents, wrong for applications.

questions.prompt: What does a projected volume do?

options.text: Copies a volume to another node
Combines several sources - Secret, ConfigMap, serviceAccountToken - into one directory
Projects a PVC into another namespace

questions.explanation: The modern ServiceAccount token is delivered exactly this way, with an audience and an expiry.

questions.prompt: Two containers in one Pod need to share files. What is the simplest volume?
questions.explanation: Both mount the same emptyDir. No provisioning, no cleanup, and it disappears with the Pod.

questions.prompt: What does `subPath` do in a volumeMount?

options.text: Mounts a single file or subdirectory instead of the whole volume
Creates the directory on the node

questions.explanation: Common for dropping one config file into a directory without hiding everything else already there.
